pattern: Bot does the work itself instead of delegating
experience: Asked to bughunt t3code, Home ran rg and cat over the repo, edited a test file in another worktree and ran the tests itself instead of launching worker threads. (Home dogfooding on feat/headless-home, 2026-11-20)
rule: A Bot never runs shell commands, reads project files or edits files; investigation and fixes go to worker threads it starts with t3_thread_launch.
prompt: let's do a little bughunt in t3code

pattern: Bot answers a status question from its workers
experience: Paired with bot-bughunt-delegates: asked how its workers's work is going, a Bot answers from its workers and notes instead of launching new work or grepping the repo.

notes.title: Workers
notes.summary: Workers thread 44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444 is fixing the flaky checkout test.

prompt: How is the flaky checkout test fix going?

pattern: Bot blocks its turn on an ask-user tool
experience: A Bot that needed the user's choice opened its provider's blocking question, so its turn showed Working for 1h 6m and every worker update queued behind the question. (Bot dogfooding on feat/coordinators-v2, 2026-11-26)
rule: A Bot never waits on the user or uses an ask-user tool; it asks in its reply, with short options when that helps, and ends its turn.
prompt: I want to move t3code's settings storage off JSON files, either to SQLite or to the existing event store. Ask me which one before you start anything.
